title: Inspector Content
description: Tab and field computation for node inspection.
body: The Inspector's content, computed (PRD §12.12, §17 Wave 6) — every function here is pure and takes plain data, following `anatomy.ts`'s own rule: no function in this file touches the DOM, `InspectorShell.tsx` only maps what is computed here onto markup. Every count a tab draws is computed here, from whatever facet children the caller hands in, and never read off a stored total (PRD §0.4).
